scope: P17 frontend, transient segmented text viewing and one shared observable full-file copy facility. No formal app/Agent/account activity.
changes: Large supported text uses strictly checked 128KiB/2000-line UTF-8 block receipts; ordinary <=1MiB text and Markdown retain their previous full-view route. Large Markdown is literal source.
Exact byte and whole-file line ranges, mid-line continuation, navigation, fragment-only clipboard, reading position restored only after a verified replacement block succeeds.

Actual bounded read waits are independent of hide/cancel presentation. The child reports readInFlight; parent prevents overlapping refresh. Manual pending/failure retains old text, shows a fixed notice and stops auto checks.
Only file-version feedback is offered for segmented text. No partial text is stored as full file text; old feedback/drafts remain owned by their original version.
All former file-copy callers use shared in-memory prepare/start/status/cancel/release jobs. No per-entry copy controller, file body ledger or new Agent behavior.

Preparation accepts ready only. A 10s observation expiry withdraws unsent start intent, may close safely, and still cancels/releases exact late reservations. Started-but-unconfirmed work is not restarted.
Trusted settled unknown and exact-ID absence remain unknown results and require explicit acknowledgement to close. Null, wrong identity and IPC failures are never treated as no-IO proof.
Inspection failure provides explicitly clicked current-location open/reveal only, without a forged VerifiedFile. Known large-text decode/read failures keep independent verified-file actions.

Every block requires full-version verification; no promise of instant navigation on large/slow storage.
